pitch_calibration.method: Original instrument's first 8192 samples (or repeating loop), 8-fold interpolation, autocorrelation peak in the configured 227–268 sample period band; parabolic refinement.

3.tradeoff: Accepted pulse waveform and quiet fixed sustain; source envelope, filtering and harmonic balance are approximated

synth_input.scope: Source lifetime is advanced before the selected passage on the host; no preroll audio is included. Kept SID channels use original timing/periods and approved sound templates; their timbre/envelopes are approximations.

selected_candidate.notes: Real PCM trigger at start; exact gain fixed during each held note;8-bit banks,126-cycle SID voice. SID channel roles are proposals requiring recipe-confidence/listening review.

scope: A bounded MOD audition, using unchanged accepted SID-voice runtime and reusable original eight-bit sample banks. SID sounds reuse approved templates; omissions and approximations are explicit. Not a full-song or exact four-channel conversion.

native_playback.scope: Streaming verification of every sampled input and latch, every ordered ordinary-voice frequency/control write and its frame, completed buffers and constant master volume. Does not establish original timbre, physical SID fidelity or perceived balance.

audio.processing: Actual VICE WAV, clock-anchored crop, DC removal and one constant gain. No host mixing, EQ, alignment, time stretching or dynamics.
